finished_message: all stages done: results are on the Results page

notes.intake: Rule-based guess: line ID from the folder name (scans/<line>/<k>.png), matches 100% of images against the samples in genetic/kernels.vcf.gz.
notes.images: Every scan has a colour card in the corner, so colour is corrected from it and the card is painted out. White balance differs between the two scanners, so each is matched to its card. 42 scans show two touching seeds and 17 seeds are cracked: excluded. Every seed is turned tip-up and centred.
notes.traits: Seven measurements on the segmented seed: length, width, area, roundness, colour, germ share and surface texture, measured the same way on real and generated seeds.
notes.genetics: 21,604 markers on 1,200 lines is too many columns to read directly, so the markers are compressed to 140 PCA scores.
notes.training: small gives about 3,900 parameters per image for this simple image variety; 250 diffusion and 60 LiteVAE epochs.
notes.qc: Both runs converged without spikes. The genotype gain is about the same on held-out and training lines, so the model is not memorising. Use the best checkpoint, epoch 244.

qc_issues: Diffusion (small) converged: validation loss is flat from about epoch 220 (best at epoch 244). Genotype gain 0.052 on held-out lines and 0.055 on training lines: no sign of memorisation.
copy: Images plus a genotype file. Here: 9,600 seed scans and a VCF of 21,604 markers.
Code matches every scan to its line, reads the VCF and finds the trait table.
When the rules aren’t sure, an AI agent decides: touching seeds, cracked seeds, a colour card in every scan.
Size, shape, colour and germ, and a compact way to read 21,604 markers.
It sizes the model and writes the job scripts for the university cluster.
The agent read the loss curves, confirmed the model wasn’t memorising and picked the checkpoint.
Every trait scored on 240 held-out lines against genomic prediction. From a folder to this, no code written.
